title: Lost Cat
description: A worried townsperson has lost their cat. Defeat a Cat and return here for a reward.

title: Nasty Thieves
description: A local merchant has reported thieves stealing from their shop. Defeat them and return here for a reward.

title: Fast Travel System
description: Use the Fast Travel System to quickly move to a different location, next one is for free!

title: Spooky Area
description: A local villager has reported a spooky area in the dungeon. Reach depth 15 without dying and return here for a reward.

title: Charity
description: A homeless villager is looking for scraps of gold, spend 55 gold to give it to the villager... Sharing is caring!
